format: Condensed record of assertions executed through actual browser tools, not a screenshot or a raw tool transcript.

Healthy sample only starts with BLOCK while the aggregate sample remains healthy and candidate-b/c show Unknown.
Every rendered trace entry starts with synthetic followed by the separator.
The exact training/synthetic/not-live banner is visible.
Request/pageerror listeners spanning reload and these actions assert no non-file request protocols and no page errors.

Controls, live result, table, and trace are identical after both Resets; the evaluation audit counter is intentionally outside this semantic comparison.
